2607.26640.title: Contrastive ESA: Human Evaluation of Multiple Translations at Once
2607.26640.paper_summary: Current human evaluation of machine translation typically assesses single outputs in isolation, a paradigm that suffers from high annotator noise and cost. We introduce Contrastive Error Span Annotation (cESA), a protocol that presents multiple translations of the source input (text, video, audio, image). In cESA, the annotator sees multiple translations of the same document, marks major and minor error spans, and then assigns a score from 0% to 100% on absolute scale. By allowing annotators to access the shared context across multiple outputs, cESA facilitates more consistent and efficient judgments. We validate cESA using a large-scale human evaluation of English->Japanese translations of 12 models, demonstrating reductions in annotation time and noise compared to standard pointwise evaluation. Unlike existing contrastive ranking methods, cESA yields absolute quality judgments that enable simple, interpretable non-parametric model rankings without the need for post-hoc corrections.
2607.26640.paper_summary_zh: 目前對機器翻譯的人工評估通常是孤立地評估單一輸出，這種範式受到高標註者噪音和成本的困擾。我們引入了對比錯誤範圍標註（cESA），這是一種呈現多個來源輸入翻譯（文本、視頻、音頻、圖像）的協議。在cESA中，標註者可以看到同一文件的多個翻譯，標記主要和次要錯誤範圍，然後在絕對尺度上給出從0%到100%的分數。通過允許標註者訪問多個輸出之間的共享上下文，cESA促進了更一致和高效的判斷。我們使用對12個模型的英語到日語翻譯的大規模人工評估來驗證cESA，顯示出與標準逐點評估相比，標註時間和噪音的減少。與現有的對比排名方法不同，cESA產生絕對質量評判，使得簡單、可解釋的非參數模型排名成為可能，而無需事後修正。
